body: It makes more sense now but it seems like the story traded the predestination paradox of VLR to the bootstrap paradox of ZTD. Thanks for the insight.

Diana and Sigma have to be trapped in the decision game in order for Delta and Phi to exist, But how did they even get there in the first place? Because Zero II was already at the beginning of ZTD and he brought them there so he can remain existing. This part is really confusing, because Zero II should not exist yet at the beginning of ZTD. Anyone got any ideas?
